title: Japanese Crusty Tapioca Cake
description: A rich, nostalgic Japanese dessert that combines the crunch of tapioca with a crumbly texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, flour, and tapioca pearls.
Add the softened butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract until well combined.
Gradually add the milk, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9-inch (23cm) round cake pan.
Top with the crumble topping, spreading it evenly.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let the cake cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
